Method of Attack: Spoofing internal package names and publishing them to an open source registry with an abnormally high version number
Misspelling the name of a popular component and relying on developers making the mistake of adding the vulnerable version
Spoofing a known brand name closely enough to bait developers into integrating malicious packages
Gaining access to the source code of a library through compromise or pretending to be a benevolent open source committer, then introducing malicious changes masquerading as harmless code changes
Attack Vector: Build systems introducing malicious code into applications
